dct_creator_sm: Santana Quintero, Mario (Carleton University). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3836-9714
dct_description_sm: This is a dataset of information compiled on a masonry building in Montreal for CMHC project by McGill University, the University of Toronto, and Carleton University entitled Digital twin-informed engineered timber retrofits for sustainable preservation and reuse of existing housing supplies, aimed at addressing the acute shortage of housing and promoting the preservation and renovation of existing structures.
